summary.text: Operations manager who led a team of 14 dispatchers and warehouse leads, owned a $2.1 million operating budget, and managed trucking vendors at Summit Freight Logistics. During a career break, tracked a $40,000 yearly budget in Excel as a neighborhood association treasurer.

Presented the budget at quarterly association meetings.
